name: Zoo Vet
summary:
Lions, tigers and bears... oh, my! In this game you'll get up close and personal with wild animals, because you are one of their doctors! Assume the role of a zoo veterinarian where you can pet, talk to and treat all types of animals in need of help. Every type of animal imaginable is a guest at this world-class zoo and you'll have the opportunity to meet dozens of them in Zoo Vet.

There are several difficulty modes to choose from. You'll receive help along the way from zookeepers and other veterinarians on staff. Look up facts and play animal trivia to learn more about all of the animals. Earn up to 1,000 per case. The number of points determines what trophies and awards you win. If you do well enough, you will unlock more challenging cases and the praise of your co-workers. Win the game by getting a permanent job at the zoo.

Travel to each of the animal habitats to perform examinations and evaluate the problems. Use 40 medically-accurate tools - even perform surgeries when needed! Go back to your office to relax, play bonus mini-games or to do research.

The game features a simple point-and-click interface, rendered 3D graphics and voices by real actors and actresses. Zoo Vet is a family-oriented game for all ages.
